caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a ladder-back design, featuring four horizontal, wavy slats on the backrest. The chair has two armrests that curve outward and downward, connected to the front legs. The overall frame of the chair is composed of light brown wood, and it rests on four square legs connected by horizontal supports near the base. The seat is upholstered and covered with a green fabric, which has a subtle diamond or grid-like pattern. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color, with a thin, rectangular border framing the drawing. There is no additional furniture or decoration in the composition, and the artist's signature, "FRANCIS LAVD DURAND," is present in the bottom right corner.
title: Shaker Chair
